overview_description.description: Cercli is an AI-powered HR, payroll, and workforce management platform designed for businesses operating across global and MENA markets. It automates employee onboarding, payroll processing, compliance, attendance tracking, and benefits administration. Cercli helps companies streamline HR operations, reduce administrative workload, and manage distributed teams efficiently through a unified platform.
